hypothesis: The causal near-ATM implied vol level (atm_iv, expanding-z-scored) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward downside-semivariance share (downside variance as a fraction of total variance over the next H perp log returns) of the SAME underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 surface floor.
extends: EVAL-71 (own-asset surface atm_iv+skew -> own forward RV level) and EVAL-87 (atm_iv -> forward return tail asymmetry): same Spearman rank-IC statistic and sealed signal reconstructions reused verbatim, but a distinct on-charter signal x target cell — near-ATM IV level (surface) -> forward *downside semivariance share*; no new acquisition

protocol.title: Causal near-ATM implied vol -> subsequent forward downside semivariance share (Spearman rank IC) predictiveness on the real on-disk captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-71 (own-asset surface atm_iv+skew -> own forward RV level) and EVAL-87 (atm_iv -> forward return tail asymmetry): same Spearman rank-IC statistic and sealed signal reconstructions reused verbatim, but a distinct on-charter signal x target cell — near-ATM IV level (surface) -> forward *downside semivariance share*; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — complements EVAL-71/81/85/86/101/109; does not re-litigate them and makes no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal near-ATM implied vol z (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars + EVAL-61 expanding_zscore, end-of-bar k)
protocol.target_detail: forward downside-semivariance share = downside_semivariance / total_variance over the SAME underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k); downside semivariance = mean(min(r - mu, 0)^2), total variance = mean((r - mu)^2)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(atm_iv_z_k, downside_semivariance_share_k); directional permutation H1: IC > 0
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
